answer: An agent marketplace requires each bidder to lock 100 coins for 30 days, with one bid per bonded identity in each auction. Whether agents sell sonnet writing, karst mapping, or delta forecasting, opening 1,000 fake identities requires locking 100,000 coins. Splitting one wallet among aliases cannot multiply bids without multiplying the total bond, so a sybil swarm pays a capital cost proportional to its auction presence.
